title: REQ · YAML content loader and reference validator
summary: Load world.yaml and scenes/*.yaml and report invalid references
description: Context: content is declarative YAML. Desired behavior: loadWorld(dir) reads world.yaml and each listed scene file and returns {world,scenes}; validateWorld returns error strings for unknown scene, object, character and flag references. Expected result: content authors get precise errors. Why: coding agents add content safely.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid content directory, when loadWorld runs, then it returns the world and every scene listed in world.yaml.
Given a goto_scene event to an unknown scene, when validated, then an error names the scene.
Given a say event with unknown character, an event on an unknown object, or an unknown flag, when validated, then an error names that reference.
Given a missing scene file or malformed YAML, when loaded, then loadWorld throws an error naming the file.
